sequence.name: CS_TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___Configure

control.block: prescaler = 1; // A missing output clock selects no prescaling.
// Parallel TRACECLK runs at half the symbol rate. prescaler = prescaler / 2;
Message(2, "Error: TPIU trace clocks cannot produce a valid divisor (input %u Hz, output %u Hz)", __traceclockin, __traceclockout);

Write32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0xFB0, LAR_KEY); // TPIU Lock Access Register: Unlock TPIU Write32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x010, prescaler - 1); // Program asynchronous clock prescaler. Write32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x0F0, 0x00000002); // TPIU Selected Pin Protocol Register: Select SWO

Write32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0xFB0, LAR_KEY); // TPIU Lock Access Register: Unlock TPIU Write32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x010, prescaler - 1); // Program asynchronous clock prescaler. Write32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x004, 1 << (tracePortWidth - 1)); // TPIU Current Synchronous Port Width Write32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x0F0, 0x00000000); // TPIU Selected Pin Protocol Register: Select Sync Trace Port ffcrValue = Read32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x304); ffcrValue |= 0x00000002; // Enable continuous formatting Write32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x304, ffcrValue); // TPIU FFCR

sequence.block: __ap = savedAP; Message(0, "End CS_TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___Configure @0x%08X, AP 0x%08X", TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS, TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___AP);

sequence.name: CS_TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___Capture
CS_TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___Flush
sequence.block: // Configure "local" TPIU for Sync Trace ffsrValue = Read32(TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x300);

control.info: Formatter not stopped, do it now
Wait for TPIU manual flush to complete
Wait for TPIU flush in progress to clear

sequence.block: __ap = savedAP; Message(0, "End CS_TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___Flush @0x%08X, AP 0x%08X", TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS, TPIU___INSTANCE_INDEX___AP);
